description: Implement a worker heartbeat system that periodically reports worker status and resource utilization to the Temporal server. This system should track worker health, collect system resource metrics, and ensure proper cleanup during worker shutdown. The feature requires integrating heartbeat functionality across all worker types and removing the external resource tuner dependency.
functional_requirements: Create a heartbeat worker that periodically sends worker status and system resource metrics to the Temporal server
Implement system resource measurement capabilities to collect CPU, memory, and other resource utilization data from the host system
Integrate heartbeat functionality across all worker types (workflow, activity, nexus, and local activity workers)
Ensure workers always send a final shutdown heartbeat during cleanup, regardless of sticky queue configuration
Centralize namespace verification at the aggregated worker level and cache results for heartbeat efficiency
Remove external resource tuner dependency and migrate necessary functionality into the core SDK
